HyperspaceAnomaly.title: ⚡ Hyperspace Anomaly
HyperspaceAnomaly.description: Your sensors detect an unusual energy signature in hyperspace.

outcome.description: You investigate and find rare materials
outcome.message: You discover valuable materials! +500 credits, +2 tons of Computers, +10 reputation

outcome.description: You safely avoid the anomaly
outcome.message: You safely avoid the anomaly and continue your journey.

NavigationError.title: 🧭 Navigation Error
NavigationError.description: Your navigation systems are behaving erratically.

outcome.description: You correct the navigation error
outcome.message: Navigation corrected, but you used extra fuel.

outcome.description: You continue despite the error
outcome.message: You arrive at your destination but used more fuel than expected.

RescueSignal.title: 🛸 Rescue Signal
RescueSignal.description: You detect a distress signal from a nearby vessel.

outcome.description: You investigate and find a genuine distress call
outcome.message: You rescue the crew! +400 credits, +2 tons of Luxury as thanks, +20 reputation.

outcome.description: You ignore the distress signal
outcome.message: You ignore the signal and continue your journey.

SpaceDebris.title: 🗑️ Space Debris Field
SpaceDebris.description: You encounter a field of space debris from an old battle.

outcome.description: You salvage valuable materials
outcome.message: You salvage valuable materials! +200 credits, +3 tons of Minerals, minor hull damage.

outcome.description: You carefully navigate around the debris
outcome.message: You safely avoid the debris field.

AlienEncounter.title: 👽 Alien Encounter
AlienEncounter.description: An alien vessel approaches your ship.

outcome.description: You successfully communicate with the aliens
outcome.message: The aliens are friendly! +300 credits, +15 reputation.

outcome.description: You flee from the alien vessel
outcome.message: You escape but take some damage and use extra fuel.

outcome.description: You engage in combat with the aliens
outcome.message: You win the battle! +400 credits, but significant hull damage.

GovernmentInspection.title: 🛡️ Government Inspection
GovernmentInspection.description: Government officials are requesting an inspection of your vessel.

outcome.description: You comply with the government inspection
outcome.message: Inspection completed. -50 credits for fees, +10 reputation.

outcome.description: You attempt to bribe the officials
outcome.message: Bribe successful. -100 credits, minor reputation loss.

outcome.description: You resist the government inspection
outcome.message: You resist but lose any illegal cargo and reputation.

MilitaryPatrol.title: 🚨 Military Patrol
MilitaryPatrol.description: A military patrol vessel is approaching your ship.

outcome.description: You properly identify yourself to the military
outcome.message: Standard procedure completed. +5 reputation.

outcome.description: You attempt to evade the military patrol
outcome.message: You evade but take damage and use extra fuel.

outcome.description: You engage in combat with the military patrol
outcome.message: You defeat the patrol! +800 credits, but heavy damage and reputation loss.

Wormhole.title: 🌌 Wormhole Detected
Wormhole.description: A mysterious wormhole has appeared in your path. It could lead anywhere...

outcome.description: You enter the wormhole and emerge in an unknown system
outcome.message: The wormhole has transported you to an unknown location!

outcome.description: You carefully navigate around the wormhole
outcome.message: You safely avoid the wormhole and continue your journey.

outcome.description: You engage in combat with the pirates
outcome.message: The pirates open fire!

outcome.description: You attempt to flee from the pirates
outcome.message: You escape but lose up to 3 tons of cargo and take damage.

outcome.description: You surrender to the pirates
outcome.message: You surrender and lose up to 5 tons of cargo and 200 credits, but avoid damage.
